scope: Fourteen actual later art returns viewed across five immutable comparison pages, with seven complete raw refinements. Eleven passes staged separately: source140 later1/2, source141 later2 and all eight first source142 repairs. Three open-neck outputs retain visible narrow neck columns and are actually rejected here. Antonia actual thin WHITE inner smile strip is restored; Miguel cap now retains natural gold texture/footprint without the previous readable anchor; Mehmet pale crown is visibly fine short white hair in full raw, not a newly invented cloth cap; Kalkus restored small gold hanging fitting has natural material and actual footprint, no new named order. This report does not mark the three remaining open-neck sources complete.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Exact source/white/cyan/alpha comparison and complete newest raw actually viewed. The rounder head still sits on a separate elongated, narrow yellow NECK COLUMN tapering down into the open V. This remaining defect has not passed. Anatomical correction: give the mascot a broad rounded upper torso/shoulders directly beneath the compact near-round head; the definite curved lower chin should meet a VERY SHORT BROAD transition at shoulder level, without any separate human-like vertical stalk. Retain source-exposed upper-chest area inside the OPEN V as broad mascot upper-body surface, not as a narrow neck triangle. Fit the existing garment circumference/shoulders around that broad body. Do not solve this by closing the V, adding a new high collar/shirt/tie or cream bib, hiding the opening, or merely shortening the old thin neck a little. Preserve actual dark open garment, exact source hair/facial-hair state, actual accessories, face direction/gaze/expression/light/crop and complete original opaque photograph/card. Keep all unrelated details of the current raw. One new actual art correction, not a service retry.
